title: Migration rehearsal and safe data evolution
problem: A rendered migration plan does not prove execution or recovery works.
rationale: Rehearsal before merge where executable, and artifact/schema-bound staging proof before production; no schema/data cap grandfathering. Human approval remains required for production mutation.
applicability: Changed migrations or schema, before merge and again before production as applicable.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: changed migrations/schema paths trigger review and run the project's own migration tool against an approved disposable DB/fixture with the relevant schema version; validate resulting schema, app compatibility and recovery rehearsal. A plan/SQL render is additional evidence, not a substitute for executing the rehearsal.
target_check.reviewer: expand/contract compatibility, destructive/data-loss risk and rollback/forward-fix plan.
